svg.title: N=45 disk-bounded lattice-site / polystick configurations
svg.desc: Vector plot generated from exact rational circle-lattice witness data.
svg.text: Physical integer lattice Z². Blue dots are selected sites; blue bars join horizontal/vertical neighbors only. No filled-square semantics are used.
blue = strict selected site • amber = boundary selected site • gray = ambient lattice site • red = circle / center
